## Triage: first grade, `priority:p3` · `domain:cli` · `area:api` · `documentation` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-17T03:58Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Still on the 18 line:** measured on 17.7.0, which ships no further release; re-read on `origin/main` `462d02f00a`. The comments are still there: `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts:407`, `:433` (the `lead.hook.ts` / `case.hook.ts` pointer) and `:507`, `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:9090`–`:9095` ("falls open"), and `examples/app-crm/src/views/lead.view.ts:102`.
- **Why p3:** comments and docs only; the runtime is right. The "falls open" sentence is the misleading part an AI author reads, and it goes in the same change.
- **Why `domain:cli`:** `packages/rest`, and the CRM example exercises that door.

- `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`: the comments at about `:411`, `:437` (the stale `lead.hook.ts` / `case.hook.ts` pointer) and `:527`. Comment-only unless measurement shows `permissions: ['guest_portal']` (about `:531`) does nothing; then the report states the fork rather than editing behaviour.
- `examples/app-crm/src/views/lead.view.ts` (about `:95`–`:106`) and `examples/app-crm/src/security/sales-positions.ts` (`GuestPortalProfile`, about `:63`–`:73`), with `security/index.ts` and the CRM access matrix only if the profile is dropped.
- `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx`, only if `guest_portal` keeps a real role on this path (`domain:devx`, declared if touched).
- **Revised 2026-10-18T01:09Z (seat review of PR #24237, patch round 1):**
  - `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`: the `guest_portal` passages only (about `:50`, `:105`–`:125`, `:250` on `7715d049e`). The page says the set and the `anonymous` flag are attached "for back-compat" with object hooks, and that a set must be kept INSERT-only. The dev's probes on `c564b0e45` measured that no hook sees either key and that the set's object bits are not read on this path. `domain:devx`, declared on #20163.
  - `examples/app-crm/src/objects/lead.object.ts`: the `status` field's comment only (about `:44`–`:46`, "the option `default` below is only a UI preselect"). PR #24237's new `form-routes.ts` pointer sends readers to `crm_lead.status`, and the engine applies a select's `default: true` option on write when no `defaultValue` is declared.
  - In-place fix of adjacent defects, by the four conditions: the same defect class (text that misstates what authorizes or fills the public submit); mechanical (text only, no behaviour); unclaimed (no open PR's file list and no `pm:dispatched` claim names either file, read in this act); and the same gate family as this card's own docs and example edits.
- **Revised 2026-10-18T01:33Z (seat review of PR #24237 at `91ca7f3b7`, patch round 2):** `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`'s error-table row `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` (about `:229`), which says "the resolved profile does not allow create on the target object". That is the same claim, and round 1's section 2 now states the opposite: no profile admits or limits the insert. The row is corrected to the refusals the grant branch actually answers `403` for, as measured. The four conditions hold as for round 1.
- A changeset or `skip-changeset`, by what a reader of the published packages sees.
- ⛔ Hold-offs:
  - every other line of `rest-server.ts` (#23050 13b is moving `/meta` G4; PRs #24223 and #24232 edit the class head);
  - the submit route's behaviour;
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-security` (read only);
  - every `packages/spec` path.
Container & model: `S`-to-`M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "Model tier — no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: the submit route's docstring and `form-routes.ts` comments in `packages/rest`, and the CRM example's comments, say the `guest_portal` profile authorizes an anonymous form submit and that a deployment without it "falls open" | none: the runtime's `publicFormGrant` already authorizes from the form declaration, which the docs state, and nothing corrects the comments | every author (human or AI) who reads the example or the docstring; measured by the `repo:www.objectos.ai` seat on 17.7.0 (`examples/app-crm` without `GuestPortalProfile`: the same 201 / 401 answers)
Thread-read: 6229356773
Serial constraints cleared:
- Open PRs, file lists read in this act:
  - #24223 and #24232 edit `rest-server.ts` only in the imports and the class head (`fetchCurrentMetaDocument`; `:3208`, `:3414`);
  - no open PR touches `form-routes.ts`, the two CRM files or `public-data-collection.mdx`.
- #23050 13b (this seat, in flight) moves `rest-server.ts`'s `/meta` G4 block (about `:5345`–`:6235`), far from the `registerFormEndpoints` JSDoc. Whichever lands second merges `main`.
- #15204's claim names `examples/app-crm` position declarations. That stage has landed (the positions carry `permissionSets` on `main`), its last activity is 2026-10-11, and it has no open PR.
Scope: the maintainer, in this session's chat, verbatim: 「p3 任务也可以开始处理」.
